subject: Mutual Action Plan: Cobaltan Analytics - Post-signature rollout & canary
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@cobaltan.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@cobaltan.com>, Anita Singh <anita.singh@cobaltan.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Signed SOW and next steps for rollout

Soojín —

Thanks again for getting the SOW over the finish line. We've signed and returned the countersigned copy (attached). Our implementation lead (Priya) and infra lead (Anita) are on this thread.

High level ask: we'd like a MAP that embeds the go-live timeline, a canary plan (small percent of traffic), migration steps from our legacy on-prem stack, and a training schedule for our support and ML ops teams. Target go-live window is the week of July 19; earlier is better if feasible.

Can you share a first-pass MAP and a short checklist we can review with the engineering stakeholders? Also confirm what telemetry/logs Redwood will expose during canary.

Attachments: Cobaltan_Signed_SOW.pdf (stub)

—Jared
Jared Cole
Head of Platform Engineering, Cobaltan Analytics
-jared.cole@cobaltan.com
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@cobaltan.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@cobaltan.com>, Anita Singh <anita.singh@cobaltan.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Signed SOW and next steps for rollout

Jared — thanks and congrats on getting to signature. Attaching our draft MAP and a canary checklist for your review. I sketched a conservative 6-week timeline with a 2-week canary window and staggered training sessions. Quick answers up front:

- Telemetry during canary: token-level latency histograms, per-route error rates, token cost breakdowns, and KV cache hit metrics. We'll expose a read-only dashboard and a streaming trace hook for your observability team.
- Migration pattern: initial prefix/KV cache warming, dual-write integration for embeddings ingestion (8-hour window), and a staged cutover per region.

Attachments: RDW-Cobaltan-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft), canary-checklist.xlsx (checklist)

Proposed near-term milestones (from the MAP):
1) Kickoff + environment provisioning — target Jun 7
2) Canary prep & smoke tests — Jun 21
3) Canary traffic (5% -> 25%) — Jul 5–19
4) Training & runbooks — Jul 6–16 (four half-day sessions)
5) Full cutover window — Jul 19–23

Could Priya confirm availability for a Jun 8 technical kickoff and whether Cobaltan needs a VPC peering or Private deployment? If Private, we'll loop in security/compliance for HSM/KMS plans.

Best,
Soojín Lee
Senior Manager, Customer Implementation | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <prao@cobaltan.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@cobaltan.com>, Anita Singh <anita.singh@cobaltan.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Signed SOW and next steps for rollout

Thanks, Soojín — the MAP draft looks good overall. A few edits from our side:
- Can we shorten the canary prep to one week? Our infra team can prioritize and we prefer a compressed window: prep Jun 21–27, then live canary Jul 5–12.
- On telemetry: we'd like per-model degradation alerts in addition to per-route error rates. Can your dashboard or alerting hooks support that?
- Training: prefer three full half-day sessions instead of four to keep stakeholder time boxed.

Also FYI, Cobaltan will need a runbook for rollback that lists exact DB migration commands and a rehearse script (we'll provide details next week).

We can confirm kickoff on Jun 8 at 9am PT — Anita and I will be there. Thanks for including the checklist; the items look actionable.

—Priya
Priya Rao
Implementation Lead, Cobaltan Analytics
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <prao@cobaltan.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@cobaltan.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-02T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Signed SOW and next steps for rollout

Priya/Jared — great, thanks for the feedback. We can accommodate the compressed canary prep and reduce training to three half-day sessions. Action items updated below and I'll attach an updated MAP PDF after the kickoff.

Updated high-level plan (reflects your feedback):
- Kickoff: Jun 8, 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent)
- Environment provisioning: Jun 9–14 (we'll provision staging + canary clusters)
- Canary prep: Jun 21–27 (smoke test plan included in checklist)
- Canary traffic: Jul 5 (5%) then step to 25% by Jul 12; monitoring window through Jul 18
- Training: Jul 6, Jul 8, Jul 13 (three half-day sessions; agenda to follow)
- Full cutover target: Jul 19 (rolling cutover with rollback rehearsed)

Deliverables we'll provide by Jun 9: updated MAP PDF (RDW-Cobaltan-MAP-v2.pdf), canary checklist (finalized), training schedule (training-schedule.csv), and dashboard access. Please confirm the roll-forward date of Jul 19 is acceptable so we can lock resource calendars.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: training-schedule.csv (stub)
